text:
{collection}.{field}: no longer personal.
Old values stay sealed under person keys and new ones would not be: the field would be half erasable.
Keep .personal({{ person: "{person}" }}).
when: Under the lock's name, when `ncdb model build` or `ncdb model check` refuses the change against the previous lock, and in the error of opening with a lock the database refuses against the one it was last opened with: a personal field is no longer personal.
